title: Perfect description
text: Perfect description. The description was spot on but it just wasn’t for me.  Pockets in front too small to put my hands inside so I returned it

product_metadata.title: Joywell Tv Controller Holder for Couch Armchair Caddy Recliner Armrest Organizer Non Slip Sofa Arm Chair Caddie with 6 Pocket Storage for Magazine, Tablet, Phone, iPad, Dark Chocolate
features: 【Premium Material】: Joywell remote control holder is made of great selection of linen fabric, which is extremely durable while not losing softness. It's also wrinkle resistance, colorfast and shrink-proof. Multi-color meets your need of diverse home styles.

【Innovation Design】: The rubber patch on the back of the chair arm caddy for couch ensures non-slip from most of occasions and the sofa armrest organizer can be used in more place with the hold on the end.

【Handy Pockets】: 6 pockets of the armrest organizer are designed for your necessities. You can put newspaper, magazines, iPad and tablet into the two largest pockets, remote controls, eye-glasses, mobile phones and other portable devices into the four standard pockets, keep them handy whenever you need them.

【Widely Applicable】: This adjustable couch remote holder fits any size of armrests on couch, sofa, recliner even hanging on the wall, table and bedside. So it's really suitable for various places like living room, bedroom, office and hotel room.

【Easy Care & Install】: Our recliner chair caddy is machine washable, excellent quality makes it could be used for a long time. Put the end of remote control holder under the sofa cushion, and then pass the other end around the sofa armrest so that the hand can just get the contents of the pocket, the sofa armrest organizer will never slide off with the end pressed.
